summary: A township’s long naming project reaches the committee as a group of creeks on a single motion.
realLife: After local outreach on eight Pennsylvania streams, the federal committee grouped the proposals and approved them together.
inGame: needs: the list of streams covered by the motion and the decision on grouping them.

turns.what: The chair puts the group to a vote.
turns.pulledBy: Members agree to a single motion.
turns.writesBack: The minutes record one disposition for the listed streams..
